mentions.name: Lettered
mentions.description: A daily puzzle game with shareable replay GIFs. The author is experimenting with generating good-looking replays using gifenc without sacrificing file size for quality.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a daily puzzle game called https://lettered.io and I’ve been playing around with shareable replay gifs via gifenc. It’s been fun trying to get good looking replays without sacrificing size for quality

mentions.name: Lettered
mentions.description: A daily word game playable at lettered.io. Ongoing work uses WebGL to improve performance and UX on larger puzzles, including on older low-end devices like a 12-year-old Android phone where the game previously ran slow.
mentions.problem: Larger puzzles ran slowly on older hardware, which motivated performance improvements.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still cranking away on my daily game called https://lettered.io.

mentions.name: Lettered
mentions.description: A daily puzzle game where players solve Wheel of Fortune-style puzzles using Tetris-like letter pieces instead of letters alone. It includes a seeded puzzle generator for puzzle layout and piece creation and lets players create their own puzzles.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on my second daily game, https://lettered.io. Like if wheel of fortune puzzles were solvable with Tetris pieces instead of letters
